description: Write a resume and cover letter tailored to a Himalayas job, from the user's Himalayas profile. Use it when the user's CV is generic, they have no cover letter, or an application form asks for one. They are saved to the user's account, where the user can edit them and download a PDF. A free account gets one tailored resume and one cover letter, ever, so on a free account use them on the job the user is most likely to apply to; Himalayas Plus covers every job. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed. Use the company_slug and job_slug from job listings.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL or company page)

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

name: generate_application_documents
